description: Draw a production dieline in the signed-in person's Drint space at an exact size and return a download link (valid one hour): DXF (for CAD and cutting tables) or CF2 (for die-makers, ArtiosCAD). Give a FEFCO / ECMA code or a type from list_dielines. Length, width, height are the inside size in mm. It counts as one die download on the space's plan, as in the Drint studio (Free has none: then it says so; the PDF / SVG die is get_dieline).

code.description: A FEFCO or ECMA code, e.g. "0201", "A20.20.03.01". Give this or type.

lang.description: The user's language (vi, en, th, zh…). Default en.

name.description: A short file name, e.g. the product. Optional.

type.description: The structure's type id from list_dielines, e.g. "rte", "rsc", "bag". Give this or code.

name: make_dieline
title: Make a die-maker file
